items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the correct labels; p20 left, p300 right with the correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Log shows 100 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into plate A1, then 100 uL aspirated from A1 and dispensed into B1 with the p300; no other wells touched.
Each aspirate is preceded by a pick up tip and each is followed by a drop tip; the last action is a drop tip.
100 uL is within the p300 range; apiLevel 2.15 is valid; the simulation ran without errors.
Single transfer of 100 uL to A1 and B1 matches the task; metadata is accurate and there are no false comments.

judge.summary: The protocol performs the specified transfer exactly: 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and B1 using the p300 with fresh tips. All rubric items pass.
